bio: Thomas A. Boyle was born on 7 November 1866 in Ireland. By 1896 he was a miner living in Hazle Township, Luzerne Co., PA. He married Theresa Meier at Hazleton on 28 October 1896, the Rev. E. W. Fitzmaurice officiating. Their daughter Catharine later married Jacob W. Kemmerer.
